searchSummary: Expanded primary-source audit through 2026-09-27 spanning MinDisagree and MaxAgree, explicit and value-only outputs, unweighted and weighted input, matrix/list/combined/same-cluster access, dynamic node/edge changes, LOCAL, LCA and MPC. The original Pivot, 2013 local-query work, 2015/2021 weighted data-stream foundations, 2019–2020 query algorithms, and 2022–2026 frontiers are represented rather than an exhaustive enumeration of all papers. STOC 2024 cluster LP 1.437 claim was corrected in October 2025 to 1.485; historical records use the corrected version. The July 2026 1.3865 preprint remains distinct from published 2025 results. Source locators, oracle assumptions, output types and conditional lower bounds are explicit; models and guarantees with different quantifiers must not share a plotted frontier.

coverage.note: Edge-label updates and node insertions/deletions separated; oblivious and adaptive adversaries plus fixed-time success distinct.
One-pass/multipass, explicit partition, cost-only estimate, node arrival, weight/graph promises and lower bounds separated.
Matrix-only additive local labels and positive-degree dependent multiplicative Pruned Pivot treated as separate tasks.
LOCAL round result for Pivot included; parallel shared-memory results excluded from MPC/LOCAL without a simulation.
Constant/polylog rounds, machine memory and total space recorded separately; bounded arboricity and all-norms variants distinct.
Adjacency-list/array slices are separated below; inspect each oracle and output assumption.
Adjacency-matrix slices are separated below; inspect pair-query and output assumptions.
Combined, communication, same-cluster, or other query interfaces are kept separate from pure list/matrix access.
